title: Gemini CLI v0.37.0-preview.1 - Patch Release
description: Patch release that cherry-picks commit 64c928f to fix issues in v0.37.0-preview.0, creating version 0.37.0-preview.1.

title: Gemini CLI v0.36.0-nightly - Comprehensive Feature Update
description: Nightly build with extensive updates including: SandboxManager refactor to stateless architecture, new 'GEMINI CLI' logo for logged-out state, subagent tool configuration improvements, Windows sandbox expansion Phase 1 and 2.1, dynamic macOS sandbox expansion, and performance optimizations for startup time and background tasks.

title: Documentation Update and Manager Path Bug Fix
description: The windsurf.nvim repository received a documentation update that added missing configuration options to the README and fixed a bug where the manager_path configuration option was not being properly applied.

title: Continue v1.3.38 - Configuration and History Improvements
description: Release v1.3.38 for VSCode includes fixes for config.yaml handling, new session history filtering by workspace directory, and .continue/configs support. Also includes dependency updates and multiple bug fixes.

title: Continue v1.2.22 - Stability Release
description: Release v1.2.22 for VSCode with config.yaml fixes, dependency updates, and session history filtering improvements.

title: Continue v1.0.67 - JetBrains Update
description: Release v1.0.67 for JetBrains with IPC stream corruption fixes, config.yaml improvements, and dependency updates.

title: Continue v1.3.37 - Ollama Tool Support Fix
description: Removed Ollama template-based tool support gate in v1.3.37 for VSCode.

title: Continue v1.3.36 - Major Bug Fix Release
description: Comprehensive bug fix release addressing crashes, security vulnerabilities, memory leaks, and JetBrains freezes. Includes new ClawRouter provider for cost-optimized model routing.

title: Continue v1.3.35 - Model Provider Updates
description: Extensive updates including support for reasoning_content field, Responses API opt-out, multiple provider fixes (Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter), and Gemini 3 tool support.
